name: envguard-audit
description: Scans a codebase for environment variable usage (e.g. process.env, import.meta.env), identifies required configuration keys, and recommends a type-safe EnvGuard schema and safe .env.example without exposing secret values.

when: User asks to inspect or audit environment variable usage in a project
User asks what environment variables an application requires
User requests generating an .env.example template from existing source code
whenNot: User is asking to modify or rewrite production code without an audit phase
Project does not use environment variables
suggestedPrompts: Audit this project's environment variables with envguard-audit
Inspect all process.env calls and suggest an EnvGuard schema
Generate a safe .env.example template for this repository

name: envguard-setup
description: Guides the installation and configuration of EnvGuard in a Node.js/TypeScript project, generating appropriate schema files, .env.example, and startup validation checks tailored to the project's package manager.

when: User asks to install or set up EnvGuard in a project
User wants to configure startup environment validation
Project needs initial envguard.config.ts or envguard.config.json setup
whenNot: EnvGuard is already fully configured and validated in the project
User is seeking a security audit only without installing packages
suggestedPrompts: Configure startup environment validation with envguard-setup
Install and set up EnvGuard in this project
Initialize envguard.config.ts and fail-fast startup checks

name: envguard-review
description: Reviews environment variable and secret handling in a project for common security vulnerabilities (e.g. unvalidated variables, console.log leaks, missing .gitignore rules, and unmasked error outputs).

when: User requests a security review of environment configuration
User asks to check if secrets might be leaked in logs or commits
User asks to verify .gitignore and .dockerignore for secret exclusions
whenNot: User wants full penetration testing or network exploit analysis
User only wants to generate a new schema
suggestedPrompts: Review my environment variable security and .gitignore with envguard-review
Check this project for potential secret leakage in logs or error handling
Verify environment configuration security before deployment

name: envguard-ci
description: Integrates EnvGuard validation checks into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Docker entrypoints) to catch configuration drift and missing deployment secrets before shipping code.

when: User asks to integrate environment checks into GitHub Actions or GitLab CI
User wants pre-flight validation in Docker containers before starting Node.js
User wants to prevent configuration drift between environments in CI
whenNot: User has no CI/CD pipeline and does not want one configured
User is troubleshooting local application business logic
suggestedPrompts: Integrate EnvGuard into CI/CD workflows with envguard-ci
Add an environment validation step to GitHub Actions
Configure Docker pre-flight check with envguard

name: envguard-migrate
description: Guides the safe, step-by-step migration of an existing Node.js codebase from raw process.env or ad-hoc validation (dotenv, joi, envalid) to EnvGuard with zero regressions.

when: User wants to migrate an existing app from dotenv, envalid, or joi to EnvGuard
User wants to refactor raw process.env references into a typed config object
User wants zero-regression configuration modernization
whenNot: Project is completely greenfield with no existing code to migrate
User is not ready to refactor environment access
suggestedPrompts: Migrate raw process.env references to EnvGuard with envguard-migrate
Replace envalid with EnvGuard with zero regressions
Safely transition our dotenv configuration to EnvGuard

name: envguard-system-design
description: Guides software architects and AI agents through requirements gathering, system architecture selection, component boundaries, data flows, API contracts, risk assessment, and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).

when: Planning a new application, service, or major architectural feature
Documenting system architecture, component boundaries, or service relationships
Drafting Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and technical specifications
whenNot: Writing line-by-line implementation code without design needs
Designing low-level database schemas in detail
suggestedPrompts: Design the architecture for our task management application with envguard-system-design
Plan component boundaries and data flow for a multi-tenant SaaS backend
Create an ADR evaluating relational vs document storage for our workload

name: envguard-backend
description: Guides the design, implementation, and verification of secure, production-grade Node.js and TypeScript backend APIs with input validation, structured errors, EnvGuard configuration validation, graceful shutdown, and integration testing.

when: Creating or refactoring Node.js / TypeScript RESTful backend services
Implementing API routes, request validation, and structured error responses
Adding startup configuration validation using EnvGuard (guard())
whenNot: Writing frontend React components or CSS
Planning high-level distributed systems architecture
suggestedPrompts: Build a secure RESTful task API in Express with envguard-backend
Add input validation, structured errors, and health checks to our backend service
Implement graceful shutdown and EnvGuard startup validation for our Node.js API

name: envguard-database
description: Guides relational and document database schema design, indexing strategies, non-destructive migration planning, transaction management, connection pool optimization, and synthetic test fixture generation.

when: Designing or modifying database tables, collections, and relations
Planning non-destructive database migrations and schema rollbacks
Adding performance indexes and optimizing slow query patterns
whenNot: Writing HTTP API controllers or Express routes
Running destructive drop-table migrations on live production databases
suggestedPrompts: Design a PostgreSQL schema with migrations for our task system using envguard-database
Plan a non-destructive migration to add a priority field to the tasks table
Create synthetic test fixtures and connection pool configuration for SQLite and Postgres

name: envguard-frontend
description: Guides the development of responsive, component-driven React and TypeScript frontend applications with strict state management, API integration, form validation, accessible loading/error/empty states, and unit testing.

when: Building or refactoring React components, pages, forms, and layouts
Integrating client applications with RESTful backend APIs
Managing client state, data fetching, loading spinners, empty states, and error alerts
whenNot: Writing backend Express routes or middleware
Designing database tables or SQL migrations
suggestedPrompts: Build a responsive task list and creation form in React with envguard-frontend
Add loading, error, and empty states to our data-fetching components
Write component tests with React Testing Library verifying task completion toggles

name: envguard-fullstack-integration
description: Guides end-to-end full-stack integration connecting React frontends, Node.js APIs, and database persistence with shared TypeScript contracts, CORS configuration, environment boundary enforcement, and integration testing.

when: Connecting a frontend application to a backend API service
Aligning TypeScript contracts, interfaces, and request/response shapes across client and server
Configuring Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS), session cookies, and authentication headers
whenNot: Writing isolated UI styling without API integration
Writing raw SQL migration scripts without application integration
suggestedPrompts: Integrate our React frontend with our Express backend and database using envguard-fullstack-integration
Set up shared TypeScript contracts and secure CORS between client and server
Build an end-to-end integration test verifying task creation from UI to database
